newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Search continues as 50 feared drowned in Bangladesh.
newsitem.headline: Search continues as 50 feared drowned in Bangladesh.

text.p: Rescuers retrieved seven bodies and were searching for more than 40 people missing after a ferry sank in Bangladesh's flooded Jamuna river, police said on Wednesday.
They said the ferry carrying about 200 passengers sank on Tuesday in a whirlpool near Sariakandi town in the northern district of Bogra.
The remaining passengers were rescued by nearby boats, they said. Police could provide no more details.
Reporters in Bogra said the death toll could be more than 50 because no one seemed to have a precise number of passengers.
"The boatmen are missing. Some people say the boat was carrying 200 passengers, some say 250," said journalist Hasibul Hasan.
Last month more than 50 people drowned when a ferry capsized in Bangladesh's Dhanu river, northeast of Dhaka, in what one policeman described as a "fierce whirlpool".
Flooding this month has killed more than 100 people in Bangladesh.
